name: design
description: Visual design language plus motion for all UI output. Bundles three skills: clean-ux (design specs — tokens, typography, buttons, cards, sidebars), motion-ux (emotionally-driven animation with GSAP/Framer), and minimal-ux (light, editorial/agency aesthetic with advanced GSAP/Lenis animations, 3D scroll experiences). Use when building landing pages, web apps, portfolios, or dashboards and bringing them to life with animation.
